description: Read this before writing code that uses UnblockingAPI - an app, script, scheduled job or backend that fetches web pages (a rank tracker, a listings aggregator, a price monitor, …). Returns the REST API reference for calling it with plain HTTP (no SDK), how to keep the key server-side on platforms like Lovable, Replit and Next.js, how to use templates, and complete recipes. Free. Start with topic 'api', then the recipe that fits.

topic.description: 'api': the REST API for apps: request, response, errors, timeouts, keeping the key server-side. 'fetch-tuning': getting complete pages: scrolling, waiting for content, consent walls, locations. 'templates': finding and calling templates for JSON, their output shapes, building your own. 'rank-tracker': recipe: a Google rank tracker for keywords and domains. 'listings-aggregator': recipe: one page that aggregates listings (e.g. properties) from several sites. 'price-monitor': recipe: watch product prices and alert on changes.
